PHASE.NAME: Filter Engine Semantics And Shared ANSI
PHASE.GOAL: Resolve FIX/C3 and FIX/M3 by centralizing ANSI stripping and making command match semantics explicit.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: FilterEngine delegates ANSI stripping to M-UTILS so proxy output and shared utility behavior cannot diverge.
Filter definitions route literal command prefixes through match_command and regex command matching through match_command_regex.

STEPS.step-1: Add ANSI stripping regression coverage for common SGR sequences.
STEPS.step-2: Remove duplicate ANSI regex state and use crate::utils::strip_ansi from filter application.
STEPS.step-3: Add match_command_regex, validation, migration warnings, and built-in filter audit.

RISKS.RISK: Existing user filters may rely on regex-like match_command behavior; preserve compatibility with warnings before making any breaking change.
